_comment: The synthetic A2/A5 experiment's pipeline configuration, v3 (v1 2026-11-03; v2 2026-11-04, D-125: the trials' and the members' memory 96gb, was 32gb; v3 2026-11-11, D-126: the best fit of the other arm for the four searches with a term, `alt_best_fit`, block 18; decisions D-118..D-123, D-125 and D-126 of claude/SBI_decisions_and_ideas_log.md, project knowledge; specs/SPEC.md secs. 1.1, 2.4, 2.5 and blocks 11-18; the roadmap specs/roadmap/synth.yaml, steps S4 and S6). A synthetic data set ("kind": "synthetic", block 15): both arms built by the bench generator, the simulated arm S on the whole parameter box and the synthetic 'real' cohorts R0 (pi = 0) and R3 (pi = 0.3), whose theta is recorded and withheld; five searches and their best fits under one command and one core cap (D-123). Values marked [Claude's] are not the user's: they are logistics proposed with this file and can change before the first submission (--dry-run first). Every key is required; a key starting with '_' documents the key after it and is ignored.
_paths: On davinci (absolute; no '~'), beside Giulia's and LindDUP's: the SBI checkout the jobs run from, and the experiment's own folders. The banks land in <banks_root>/synth_sim and synth_real_<name>; the searches in <tune_root>/<search>/<campaign>; the best fits in <runs_root>/<search>/synth_best.
_envs: As Giulia's: the sequencer in sbi_export (the standard library only), the bank jobs, the trials and the members in sbi_env (numpy, scipy, torch).

synthetic._builder: The bench generator (D-119) at the decided shape (D-120): 180-s windows at 100 Hz (W 18,000), 100 units, two wells per donor (D-119), batches of 8 donors (the builder's default, SPEC sec. 2.4), three conditions, tau_ov 0.10, the DSN's regular simplex scaled by 0.6 about the box's centre ('medium', D-120). The centres are recorded in arm S's sidecar too and unused by its box draw.
synthetic._sim: Arm S (D-120): 20,000 theta i.i.d. on the box, 2 wells x 1 window each, 40,000 windows. seed 1000 [Claude's; D-120 asks only that the arms' seeds differ]. 2,000 wells per shard [Claude's]: 20 shards of about 120 MB, one job each, about 4 min each at the sandbox's 0.1 s per well.
synthetic._real: Arm R (D-120, D-121): two independent cohorts of 3 conditions x 9 donors x 2 wells x 6 windows (324 windows each), R0 at pi = 0 and R3 at pi = 0.3 with the three modes of the gap (D-119; at pi = 0 they are the identity). Seeds 2000 and 3000 [Claude's]: pairwise distinct from arm S's and from each other (D-120, D-121).
synthetic._searches: The five searches (D-122, D-123): S-A1 once (its trials scored on R0, its best fit scored on R3 at the evaluation), S-A2 and S-A5 on each cohort. The order is the priority under the core cap: the free cores go to the earliest search and its best fits first. alt_best_fit (D-126, block 18, added 2026-11-11 after the run of v2): true fits, beside the search's best fit, the best trial on the simulated report split's nll of the arm the search's finalist is not (A1 or the term's arm), in <runs_root>/<search>/synth_best_alt with the same best_fit values, so the evaluation has an ensemble of 5 members per arm; S-A1 has one arm (false).
synthetic._bank_job: [Claude's] One core per shard job (the builder is single-threaded), 8gb, 2 h (about 30 times the sandbox's time for a shard), queue cpu; a job that ends without its shard is submitted again twice at most.

_split: Giulia's (D-088): train / selection / report = 85 / 10 / 5 % of arm S's donors.

search._shape_anchors: The bench's theta width, 10 (the record job checks it on the bank); embedding_dim 64 as Giulia's and LindDUP's (D-123: the agreed space on the bench's anchors).
search._space_overrides: The agreed default space (D-123, the user: 'All the parameters that we have agreed on to be searched by default'): Giulia's and LindDUP's overrides (D-085, D-086), depth_exponent [3, 5], embedding_size [16, 64], head_pool_ops [0, 1]; the other axes at the code's ranges.
search._budget: The small budget (D-119): 20 initial points, then 4 GP rounds of 10, 60 trials per search.
search._max_concurrent_trials: Giulia's 25 per search; the cap (120 cores) holds 14 trials of 8 beside the sequencer's 4, shared by the five searches in their order.
search._seeds: Giulia's: gp_seed 1, train_seed 0 (one donor split of arm S for every search).
search._trial: D-123 (the card's option '8 cores, 32 GB, 24 h'): 8 cores, 24 h, queue cpu; 96gb since 2026-11-04 (D-125: 1.5 x the peak the budget gate measured on davinci, 59.3 GB at batch 1024, rounded up to 8 GB; 32gb at first); 6 passes in 20 epochs and 2 resubmissions, Giulia's (D-088). The budget gate measures the costliest configuration first and stops the run unless it projects within 24 h / 1.5.
search._max_total_walltime_h: Giulia's 400 h (D-090), per search, from its first trial's submission.

_best_fit: D-123 (the card's option '5 members, 8 cores each'): an ensemble of 5 members on one shared split (seed 1); 40 passes in 40 epochs, patience 10, 512 posterior draws, Giulia's (D-089, D-087); 96gb as the trials (D-125; 32gb at first) and 120 h [Claude's: about 40 / 6 of the trial's budget; a member killed at its walltime resumes from its checkpoint, twice at most].
_loader: [Claude's] The whole of arm S in the buffer (20 shards, about 2.9 GB of windows): exactly i.i.d. batches (D-084's buffer, at its limit).
_driver: Giulia's (D-098): the sequencer as a chain of PBS jobs pl_synth, 4 cores, 16gb, 24 h each.
_resources: D-120 (the user: '120 are ok'): the experiment's jobs, the sequencer's included, never ask for more than 120 cores at once. Each pipeline counts only its own jobs (Giulia's and LindDUP's caps are separate).
